title: need.guided_form result
description: FRS F8: the guided form for the case's category, its answers so far and what is still missing. The same value is the case's guided_form artifact.

form.description: The F8 form, null while the category (or for Works New or Repetitive) is not picked.

answers.description: Field key to the officer's answer; NA for a field skipped or ruled out.

missing.description: The mandatory fields with no answer yet.

complete.description: True when every field is settled: S1 counts the need as captured and S2 takes it in place of a precedent.
